question: In a certain code language, ‘CIRCLE’ is written as ‘DLWAHY’. How will ‘SQUARE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

‘CIRCLE’ is written as ‘DLWAHY’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/031e8869ae39f731cddf10943f58dc40581fc00a7c1f3bad5aed6087bb646017.png] 

Similarly,

**SQUARE**** **= ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ba5e3e1197953c1603daf43d94bdb3ba0796495f4608d846d441a893e076590.png] 

Hence, 'SQUARE' is coded as "**TTZYNY**".
